Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an incorrect analysis by associating the cooling of the surroundings with an exothermic reaction. In thermochemistry, an exothermic reaction releases heat, causing the surroundings to warm up. Conversely, an endothermic reaction absorbs heat, causing the surroundings to cool down. The Planner mistakenly identified the reaction as exothermic when the correct answer should have been endothermic, as the problem specifies a decrease in temperature, which indicates heat absorption by the reaction (endothermic process).
